## Add

```bash
zweb add popover
```

## Imports

Styled registry component:

```tsx
import { Popover } from '@/components/ui/popover'
```

Primitive React wrapper:

```tsx
import { Popover } from '@zeus-web/popover/react'
```

Web Component entry:

```ts
import '@zeus-web/popover/wc/auto'
```

## Props

| Prop          | Type      | Default | Description                         |
| ------------- | --------- | ------- | ----------------------------------- |
| `open`        | `boolean` | -       | Controlled open state.              |
| `defaultOpen` | `boolean` | -       | Initial uncontrolled open state.    |
| `modal`       | `boolean` | -       | Dismisses on outside pointer input. |
| `disabled`    | `boolean` | -       | Disables the trigger.               |
| `forceMount`  | `boolean` | -       | Keeps content mounted while closed. |

## Events

| Event         | React prop     | Detail                              | Description                      |
| ------------- | -------------- | ----------------------------------- | -------------------------------- |
| `open-change` | `onOpenChange` | `open: boolean, nativeEvent: Event` | Emitted when open state changes. |

## Slots

| Slot      | Description                  |
| --------- | ---------------------------- |
| `default` | Popover trigger and content. |
